description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Memory Storage Provider, verifying functionalities such as state restoration, null state handling, read/write operations, and ETag enforcement within the Orleans distributed application framework.

classes.name: MemoryStorageProviderTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of Orleans Memory Storage Provider, including state management and ETag concurrency control.

classes.name: TestGrainState
classes.description: A serializable class implementing IGrainState<object>, used in testing ETag and state management functionalities.

methods.name: MemoryStorageProvider_RestoreStateTest
methods.description: Tests whether grain state can be restored during activation.

methods.name: MemoryStorageProvider_NullState
methods.description: Verifies storage provider handling of null and non-null grain state.

methods.name: MemoryStorageProvider_WriteReadStateTest
methods.description: Checks basic write and read operations on grain state.

methods.name: MemoryStorageGrainEnforcesEtagsTest
methods.description: Validates ETag enforcement, concurrency, and state deletion behavior in the Memory Storage Grain.
